svg.title: Sound Creations Ltd Company Profile 2026 - Page 09

text.tspan: The hall’s concave walls naturally amplified reflections along their curved surfaces,
creating “whispering gallery” and “focus” effects that concentrated speech and
music in specific areas. An innovative diffuser design mitigates these defects, while
the ceiling balances sound reflectors and absorbing panels with approved NRC
values for uniform propagation from stage to audience. Acoustic carpet, fully treated
walls and acoustic doors complete a controlled auditory environment.
Diffuser acoustic design for concave geometry
Acoustic carpet and full wall treatment
